{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data to ensure fresh state
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the 'revenue' column is string and has commas
print("Sample revenue values (before):", sales['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Strip commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify conversion
print("Sample revenue values (after):", sales['revenue_float'].head().tolist())

# Check for internal test orders: revenue = 999999.99
internal_test_mask = sales['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {internal_test_mask.sum()}")

# Check status column
print(f"Status values: {sales['status'].unique().tolist()}")

# Now filter: completed orders and NOT internal test
completed_mask = sales['status'] == 'completed'
valid_mask = ~internal_test_mask
final_mask = completed_mask & valid_mask

# Compute total revenue from completed, non-test orders
total_revenue = sales.loc[final_mask, 'revenue_float'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test): {total_revenue:.2f}")"}
